name: kimv_announcement
description: FMSG recommends legally binding borrower-based measures for residential real estate lending, which the FMA implements as KIM-V.

name: kimv
description: KIM-V in force: LTV at most 90% (20% exemption), DSTI at most 40% (10%), maturity at most 35 years (5%) for new residential real estate loans to households.

name: kimv_bridging_exemption
description: KIM-V amendment: bridging loans and non-repayable government grants excluded; de minimis threshold for couples raised to EUR 100,000.

name: kimv_single_exemption_bucket
description: KIM-V amendment: the separate exemption buckets merged into one institution-specific bucket of 20% of new lending volume.
